purpose_text.para: Controls trapping to EL2 of accesses to CPACR, CPACR_EL1, trace, Activity Monitor, SME, Streaming SVE, SVE, and Advanced SIMD and floating-point functionality.

configuration_text.para: If EL2 is not implemented, this register is RES0 from EL3.
This register has no effect if EL2 is not enabled in the current Security state.

field_description.para: Reserved, RES0.
In AArch64 state, traps accesses to CPACR_EL1 from EL1 to EL2, when EL2 is enabled in the current Security state. The exception is reported using EC syndrome value 0x18.
In AArch32 state, traps accesses to CPACR from EL1 to EL2, when EL2 is enabled in the current Security state. The exception is reported using EC syndrome value 0x03.
When the Effective value of HCR_EL2.TGE is 1, this control does not cause any instructions to be trapped.

note.para: CPACR_EL1 and CPACR are not accessible at EL0.

field_value_description.para: This control does not cause any instructions to be trapped.
EL1 accesses to CPACR_EL1 and CPACR are trapped to EL2, when EL2 is enabled in the current Security state.

field_description.para: Trap Activity Monitor access. Traps EL1 and EL0 accesses to all Activity Monitors System registers to EL2, as follows:

content.para: In AArch64 state, accesses to the following registers are trapped to EL2, reported using EC syndrome value 0x18:

listitem.content: AMUSERENR_EL0, AMCFGR_EL0, AMCGCR_EL0, AMCNTENCLR0_EL0, AMCNTENCLR1_EL0, AMCNTENSET0_EL0, AMCNTENSET1_EL0, AMCR_EL0, AMEVCNTR0<n>_EL0, AMEVCNTR1<n>_EL0, AMEVTYPER0<n>_EL0, and AMEVTYPER1<n>_EL0.

content.para: In AArch32 state, MRC or MCR accesses to the following registers are trapped to EL2 and reported using EC syndrome value 0x03:

listitem.content: AMUSERENR, AMCFGR, AMCGCR, AMCNTENCLR0, AMCNTENCLR1, AMCNTENSET0, AMCNTENSET1, AMCR, AMEVTYPER0<n>, and AMEVTYPER1<n>.

content.para: In AArch32 state, MRRC or MCRR accesses to AMEVCNTR0<n> and AMEVCNTR1<n>, are trapped to EL2, reported using EC syndrome value 0x04.

field_value_description.para: Accesses from EL1 and EL0 to Activity Monitors System registers are not trapped.
Accesses from EL1 and EL0 to Activity Monitors System registers are trapped to EL2, when EL2 is enabled in the current Security state.

field_description.para: Reserved, RES0.
Enable access to POR_EL0.
Traps EL0 accesses to POR_EL0 to EL2, from AArch64 state only. The exception is reported using EC syndrome value 0x18.

field_value_description.para: This control causes EL0 access to POR_EL0 to be trapped.
This control does not cause any instructions to be trapped.

field_description.para: Reserved, RES0.
Traps System register accesses to all implemented trace System registers from both Execution states to EL2, when EL2 is enabled in the current Security state, as follows:

content.para: In AArch64 state, accesses to trace System registers with op0=2, op1=1, and CRn<0b1000 are trapped to EL2, reported using EC syndrome value 0x18.
In AArch32 state, MRC or MCR accesses to trace System registers with cpnum=14, opc1=1, and CRn<0b1000 are trapped to EL2, reported using EC syndrome value 0x05.

note.para: The ETMv4 architecture and ETE do not permit EL0 to access the trace System registers. If the trace unit implements FEAT_ETMv4 or ETE, EL0 accesses to the trace System registers are UNDEFINED, and any resulting exception is higher priority than an exception that would be generated because the value of CPTR_EL2.TTA is 1.
EL2 does not provide traps on trace register accesses through the optional Memory-mapped interface.

field_description.para: System register accesses to the trace System registers can have side-effects. When a System register access is trapped, any side-effects that are normally associated with the access do not occur before the exception is taken.

field_value_description.para: This control does not cause any instructions to be trapped.

Any attempt at EL0, EL1 or EL2, to execute a System register access to an implemented trace System register is trapped to EL2, when EL2 is enabled in the current Security state, unless HCR_EL2.TGE is 0 and it is trapped by CPACR.NSTRCDIS or CPACR_EL1.TTA.
When HCR_EL2.TGE is 1, any attempt at EL0 or EL2 to execute a System register access to an implemented trace System register is trapped to EL2, when EL2 is enabled in the current Security state.

When instructions that directly access the SVCR System register are trapped with reference to this control, the MSR SVCRSM, MSR SVCRZA, and MSR SVCRSMZA instructions are also trapped.
The exception is reported using EC syndrome value 0x1D, with an ISS code of 0x0000000.

For the purposes of this trap, the architecture defines a VMSR access to FPSID from EL1 or higher as an access to a SIMD and floating-point register. Otherwise, permitted VMSR accesses to FPSID are ignored.
